UBA|2026-10-30|UNITED BANK FOR AFRICA PL.summary:
* United Bank for Africa Plc announced that its Board of Directors met on Thursday, October 29, 2026, and approved the Group’s unaudited financial statements for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.
* The financial statements will be published alongside the Group's audited half-year financial statements, pending the requisite approval of the Central Bank of Nigeria.
* The Bank’s closed period will remain in effect until 24 hours after the financial statements are published to the investing public.

UNILEVER|2026-10-23|UNILEVER NIGERIA PLC.summary:
* Unilever Nigeria PLC has announced an interim dividend of N2.00 per ordinary share of 50k each for the period ended 30th September 2026.
* The qualification date to determine eligible shareholders is Friday, 30 October 2026, while the register of shareholders will be closed from 2 November to 6 November 2026.
* The dividend will be paid electronically on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, to qualifying shareholders who have completed their e-dividend registration.

WAPIC|2026-10-23|CORONATION INSURANCE PL.id: WAPIC|2026-10-23|CORONATION INSURANCE PLC - CAUTIONARY NOTICE AND UPDATE ON PROPOSED SCHEME OF ARRANGEMENT
WAPIC|2026-10-23|CORONATION INSURANCE PL.summary:
* Coronation Insurance Plc provided an update on its proposed scheme of arrangement with the holders of its fully paid ordinary shares, following the resolution of pending matters that had previously stalled its review by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
* The Company submitted its formal approval application to the SEC on October 16, 2026, and the Core Shareholders (Coronation Capital (Mauritius) Limited and related parties) have confirmed their intention to proceed.
* Subject to required regulatory approvals, the consideration price payable under the Scheme will be the highest trading price recorded for the Company’s shares on the Nigerian Exchange Limited (NGX) during the six months preceding the date of the notification.
* The remaining steps to implement the scheme include obtaining formal SEC approval, Federal High Court sanction, Corporate Affairs Commission filings, paying the minority shareholders, and delisting the company's shares from the NGX.
